about: Repository/cache-layer fixture. Freshness is NOT part of the Open-Meteo payload; it is derived by the client cache from fetchedAt + policy. All instants are UTC. 'referenceNow' is the evaluation instant each scenario is judged against, so these cases are clock-independent and deterministic.

policy.rule: age = referenceNow - fetchedAt. age <= freshForMinutes => fresh; freshForMinutes < age <= staleAfterMinutes => stale (usable, must be labelled stale with the fetchedAt timestamp shown); age > staleAfterMinutes => expired (do not present index values as current; show last-updated and an explicit expired/offline state).
